newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Super Group buys regional transport firm.
newsitem.headline: Super Group buys regional transport firm.

text.p: Super Group announced on Monday it had acquired Regional Transporters Ltd for about 265 million rand with effect from October 1 1996.

Regional Transporters, whose operations include Alex Carriers and the Bluefin Group, is the largest long distance transport, freight management and trading operation in Sub-Saharan Africa, Super Group said in a statement.
It said the acquisition would result in about 35 percent of Super Group's earnings being dollar denominated.
Regional Transporters results for the four years to September 30 2000 had been warranted to include taxed profits of U.S.8 million.

Super Group said that the acquisition was expected to increase its forecast earnings per share for the year to March 31 by 16 percent to 39 cents each, based on earnings attributable to the acquisition for the last six months of the year and if current market conditions prevailed.
It added that the acquisition had been approved by the South African Reserve Bank.
